attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Fixes an async-void bug in Configure (previously the settings fetch could run after resources were registered) by using a synchronous GetSettings call, but this risks blocking/deadlock if GetSettings internally does sync-over-async and it only affects the Facebook module's resource manifest."}

reason: Fixes an async-void bug in Configure (previously the settings fetch could run after resources were registered) by using a synchronous GetSettings call, but this risks blocking/deadlock if GetSettings internally does sync-over-async and it only affects the Facebook module's resource manifest.
